name: K2-155

quotes.title: K2-155d
quotes.card: K2-155d is a potentially habitable Super-Earth exoplanet in the K2-155 system.
quotes.introduction: It is the outermost of three known planets orbiting around the K-type star K2-155 in the constellation Taurus, approximately 290 light-years from Earth.
